Portuguese Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Portugal comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Portuguese documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe IRN160–590 EUR
Driving Licencethe IMT100–420 EUR
ID Cardthe IRN75–270 EUR
Green CardAIMA290–950 EUR
Visaa Portuguese consulate130–480 EUR
Residence PermitAIMA280–840 EUR

Two checks specific to Portugal

  • Check the citizen card for the chip and confirm the eight digit document number format.
  • Confirm the passport number and the shield printing on the cover.

Local red flag

  • A citizen card with a chip slot but no readable chip.
